proposal_title: Release Identity Alignment & Deterministic 4-Stage Hashing Pipeline
domain_specific_rationale: From a QA release certification and traceability perspective, aligning the release identity to v1.0.0 and establishing a deterministic, non-self-referential 4-stage hashing pipeline (individual file SHA-256 digests, canonical path sorting, tree hash, and deterministic archive hash) guarantees that QA test results are bound to an exact, tamper-evident blueprint baseline. This ensures complete auditability across CI test runs, benchmarking stages, and deployment artifacts.
capability_impact: Protects CAP-14 (Release Integrity & Governance) and ensures repeatable validation of the entire specification suite across all environments.
residual_risk: Operating system newline differences (CRLF vs LF) or file permission metadata affecting cross-platform hashing; mitigated by enforcing POSIX LF and standardizing file mode filtering in release builder tools.
